name: Charlene Krios
source:
Originally born a peasant from the Remnant Isles, Charlene is the new chairperson of the Enclave Mage Council after the last chairperson was killed in a sex magic accident. Charlene is a no nonsense battlemage of considerable power. Despite her office, Charlene actively seeks [url=https://vndb.org/c165584]Jacinta[/url] for crimes against the Enclave.
